prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, then pick it up and check its properties. If not, then move towards it or scan the area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = MoveTowardsObject    /> <Sequence>   <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />   <Action ID = PickUpObject    />   <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> </Sequence> <Fallback>   <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = PickUpObject    />     <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />   </Sequence>   <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />     <Action ID = MoveTowardsObject    />   </Sequence>   <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> </Fallback>"
code:
SELECTOR
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
				DO PickUpObject
		ELSE
			DO CheckObjectProperties
		END
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
				DO MoveTowardsObject
		END
		DO ScanAreaForObject
	END
